Maria: Quick sync — console observability snapshot, got a sec?
Jamal: On it. TL;DR?
Maria: Short: dashboards for canary are wired (queries + panels) but tracing hooks PR is blocked by an infra flag rename. Retention PR needs an owner for long-term policy (90d vs 30d). Canary start is Wed — need decisions by EOD Tue.
Emily: Dashboards PR here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/1234 — reviewers: @Wei @Jamal
Wei: Taking a look at the dashboard diffs now. For tracing hooks, what's the exact failure?
Maria: Build error in staging after the infra rollout: ```ERROR: sampler flag 'trace_sample_rate' not found
    at runtime/init.go:42``` Linked issue/PR for the tracer wrapper: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1250
Jamal: I can pair with infra tomorrow AM and patch the wrapper. @infra-bot can you confirm whether the flag rename was intentional across services?
infra-bot: infra-bot: The rename was rolled yesterday to standardize flags across JVM services. New flag is `tracing:sample_rate`. Rollout window Wed 04:00-06:00 UTC.
Emily: :thumbsup: If Jamal can pair, I'll update the tracing hooks PR to use the new flag name after the patch.
Maria: Ownership question — we still need someone to own the error-analysis view (the UI + saved queries). @Sophia? If nobody picks it up by EOD Tue we default to 30d retention.
Sophia: I can own the error-analysis view. I'll draft the schema and the saved-query set and post a short PR by EOD.
Maria: Action items: Jamal + infra pairing tomorrow 09:00 PT; Wei to finish dashboard review today; Sophia owns error view; Emily to update tracing PR after pairing. Canary decision: Tue EOD. Thanks all.
Jamal: Added to my calendar, will ping if anything slips. :calendar:
